scenes.video:
Premium extreme macro botanical cinematography. A single deep-violet iris against a seamless pure black background, with one perfectly formed transparent dew droplet resting on the front petal. Physically accurate petal microtexture and radial veins, refined studio rim lighting, rich violet tones, controlled specular highlights, realistic 100mm macro lens appearance, shallow but natural depth of field. Animate the provided reference image while preserving its exact iris geometry, petal positions, droplet shape, and composition.

Use a gentle, localized upper-left rim-light reveal across the existing petal; do not fade the whole image in from black. Camera remains locked on a tripod.
MAIN ACTION, 2–8 seconds: Keep a fixed camera and locked focus on the same attached droplet and its petal. Preserve their geometry and position. Show only subtle, physically plausible movement in the droplet's reflected studio highlight and a very gradual change in the violet rim light. Keep fine petal veins and the droplet's refracted texture visibly sharp. No zoom, no focus pull, no focus breathing.
EXIT TRANSITION, 8–10 seconds: Keep the droplet and petal crisp, fully visible, and unchanged. Create a restrained exit effect only in the surrounding black background: the violet rim-light halo gently narrows and recedes behind the flower without lowering exposure on the subject. Lock the final composition and hold it unchanged through 10 seconds. End on a clean, bright-enough, stable, detailed frame suitable for saving as the starting image of BB-002.
No morphing, no moving droplets, no duplicated petals, no flicker, no camera shake, no artificial glitter, no whole-frame fade, no subject blur, no text, no watermark.

transition_policy_v2.inter_clip_edit: direct adjacency; no added cut, dissolve, wipe, fade, or separate transition clip
transition_policy_v2.subject_lock: Preserve the main subject's identity, species, silhouette, anatomy, proportions, texture, and position; no morphing or deformation.
transition_policy_v2.change_rule: A color or subject change may happen gradually inside the clip through a realistic light, refraction, bokeh, focus, or shadow reveal. Reveal a different subject as distinct, never transform one subject into another.
transition_policy_v2.note: This v3 prompt structure updates the production instructions only. Existing renders are historical and have not been regenerated.
transition_policy_v2.entry_reference: Every clip begins on the exact supplied image: BB-001 master still or the immediately previous clip's saved last frame.
transition_policy_v2.exit_reference: End on a clean, stable, detailed frame explicitly designed to be saved and used as the next clip's starting image.

image_generation_policy.later_scenes: Do not generate separate stills. Select the previous clip's saved final frame as the next prompt's reference image.
image_generation_policy.recovery: Generate a replacement still only if a verified saved endpoint is missing or unusable; record why before spending credits.
